data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 ties resilience to an 'architectural diversity index exceeding a critical threshold,' but the problem asks for evidence that distinguishes truly independent from merely uncorrelated failure modes. A diversity index measured on observable architecture is itself vulnerable to the very confounding the problem highlights: nodes can appear architecturally diverse yet share a hidden common cause (same upstream library, same cloud provider, same protocol spec) that only manifests under a specific shock. Thus the proposed threshold criterion is a criterion based on apparent diversity, not proven independence; it does not supply the requested distinguishing evidence and can be satisfied by a population that is not truly independent.
